newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Man seizes hostages in theatre in Siberia.
newsitem.headline: Man seizes hostages in theatre in Siberia.

text.p: A man took an unknown number of people hostage in a stationery shop in a theatre in the Russian city of Omsk on Thursday and threatened to blow the building up, Itar-Tass news agency said.

Tass said it was not clear what demands the man had made. Police in the western Siberian city had surrounded the theatre and were trying to make contact with the hostage-taker. The agency gave no further details.
